2. Choose Settlement Strategy
FIFO Strategy
⭐ Recommended Standard Active

Penalties are settled strictly in chronological order (oldest logged entry first). Older penalties clear 100%, leaving clean round balances without odd decimals.

Recovers critical penalties first (e.g., COD cash collections) before routine operational deductions. Customize ranking below via Up/Down controls.

Proportional Distribution
⚖️ Weighted Average Active

Distributes available earnings across all deduction heads based on their proportional size. Every deduction gets a partial settlement.
